name: oss
description: Open Science Skills (oss). 38 Claude Code skills for experimental social science and computational text analysis. Orchestration and delegation: orchestrate (a multi-model workflow that detects whether the session runs Fable 5.1 or Opus 5 and takes the matching lead role; /fable-orchestrate and /opus-orchestrate force it), advisor (an independent-second-reviewer consult with Fable 5.1 at max reasoning effort), spawn (full peer Claude Code sessions in their own git worktrees and terminal panes via herdr, tmux, or claude background agents, briefed by contract and merged back), model-committee (a deliberative GPT-5.6 and Claude Opus 5 committee with a selectable chair via /model-committee, /model-committee-fable, /model-committee-sol), model-council-voting, and diverge (brainstorm-then-select, with --codex delegating to GPT-5.6). Research design: research-grill (a rounds-based interview that takes an idea to a falsifiable question, a question to a full design, or a draft to its reviewer objections; student-safe, credited to Matt Pocock's grill-me), research-wayfinder (decision-map planning across sessions, adapted from Pocock's wayfinder), hypothesis-building, survey-design, conjoint-design, conjoint-cleaning, conjoint-diagnostics, list-experiment, cross-national-design, pre-registration-writing, qualtrics-ops (live Qualtrics v3 operations plus a read-only pre-fielding audit mode; /survey-flow-audit is the alias), survey-data-audit. Text and documents: text-classification (including resumable batch pipelines and rule-based baselines), llm-calibration-logprobs, topic-modeling, doc-to-markdown, vlm-ocr (evaluate, run, clean; /vlm-ocr-evaluation, /vlm-ocr-pipeline, /post-ocr-cleanup are aliases), research-repo. Manuscript QA and reporting: citation-check, fact-check, literature-review, narrative-building, figures, tables, figure-table-audit, methods-reporting, paper-tex, replication-package (scaffold plus FAIR audit; /fair-check is the alias), paper-review-lite (with --codex cross-model mode; /paper-review-lite-codex is the alias), presubmit, journal-review (reviewer side), referee-response (author side: extract, order, and format the response to reviewers without writing the science). Invoke as /oss:skill-name (or /skill-name when unambiguous) or let Claude auto-trigger from context.
